stories.definitionOfDone: • Architecture Design: The architecture design document includes: system components diagram, data flow diagrams, interface specifications, and technology stack decisions. All components are documented with their responsibilities and interactions. • Database Schema Design: The database schema includes: all required tables with relationships, indexes for performance, data validation rules, and migration scripts. Schema is reviewed and approved by the database team. • Data Storage Solution: The data storage solution includes a scalable and secure data warehouse that can handle large amounts of weather data, with data redundancy and backup mechanisms in place. • Data Processing Algorithm: The data processing algorithm is implemented using a combination of machine learning models and statistical techniques to accurately predict weather patterns and forecast conditions. • User Interface Design: The user interface design includes: intuitive navigation, clear data visualization, and secure authentication mechanisms for authorized users to access and manage weather data.
stories.description: The weather station system must collect, process, and archive weather data so that other systems can use it for accurate forecasting.
stories.source_quote: The system collects data from ALL wilderness weather stations, processes and analyzes it, and archives it in a retrievable format for other systems, such as weather forecasting systems.
stories.title: Weather Station System

stories.definitionOfDone: • Communication With Weather Stations: The communication module is fully implemented, including satellite protocol integration, data serialization, and deserialization. The system can successfully send and receive data with weather stations via satellite.
stories.description: The system must communicate with weather stations via satellite to monitor health, provide reports of problems, and update embedded software.
stories.source_quote: The system communicates with weather stations via satellite to monitor health, provide reports of problems, and update embedded software.
stories.title: Communication with Weather Stations

stories.definitionOfDone: • Data Collection: Data collection is complete when the system successfully collects and stores weather observation data for a minimum of with accurate temperature measurements taken every minute.
stories.description: The system must collect weather observations at frequent intervals, such as temperature measurements every minute.
stories.source_quote: The system operates by collecting weather observations at frequent intervals, such as temperature measurements every minute.

stories.definitionOfDone: • Local Data Storage: The local data storage solution includes: a reliable data store with automatic backup and versioning, data encryption for security, and efficient data retrieval mechanisms. All data is verified to be consistent across all instances of the system.
stories.description: If communication fails, the system maintains data locally until connection is resumed.

stories.definitionOfDone: • Power Management: The power management system includes: automatic battery charging during favorable weather conditions, generator shutdown during severe weather (high wind), and a backup plan for critical systems during generator failure.
stories.description: The system ensures batteries are charged when possible, but shuts down generators in potentially damaging weather conditions, such as high wind.
